description: DIMAG WebGIS provides a WebGIS and route simulator for historical maritime trade using vessel performance and weather. The provider is DIMAG research project, University of Trier. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: This models ancient maritime connectivity; it is not a current commercial fleet simulator. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration.
